hero.title: Your US Visa,
hero.desc: Cutting-edge technology and professional guidance to fast-track your consular appointment and guarantee a flawless DS-160 presentation.

process.title: Our Methodology
process.desc: A rigorous framework designed to minimize rejections and dramatically accelerate wait times.
process.step1_desc: Experts review every detail of your profile to maximize the probability of approval.
process.step2_desc: Our algorithm scans global consulates looking for the first available slots.
process.step3_desc: Upon detecting cancellations, we secure your appointment in milliseconds with no human intervention.
process.step4_desc: Receive mock interviews and guidance until you walk out with your approved visa.

agency.title: Power your agency with global technology.
agency.desc: We offer a white-label portal for travel agencies and visa consultants to provide appointment expediting services under their own brand, powered by our technical infrastructure.

pricing.b2c_basic_desc: The professional baseline to start your process with confidence.
pricing.b2c_std_desc: The ideal balance. Guaranteed appointment in under 3 months.
pricing.b2c_pro_desc: Maximum urgency. Guaranteed appointment in 1 month or less.

testimonials.title: Impeccable Reputation
testimonials.t1_text: The level of professionalism is impeccable. I had my appointment scheduled for next year and they managed to pull it forward to 3 weeks. Essential for my business trips.
testimonials.t2_text: A completely transparent process. The dashboard kept me informed, and the team reviewed my DS-160, correcting errors that would have cost me the visa.
testimonials.t3_text: We operate over 100 profiles monthly through the Pro plan. The neutral platform allows us to maintain our brand in front of the client.
